definition.name: Lower Parking Surface
definition.description: Sets a height offset (mm) on parking bays picked by Comments prefix, walls picked by type name prefix and rooms picked by name; can lower a plan view range, and stops if doors or specialty equipment would move.
definition.aiDescription: Sets a height offset (mm) on parking bays picked by Comments prefix, walls picked by type name prefix and rooms picked by name; can lower a plan view range, and stops if doors or specialty equipment would move.
examples: lower the parking surface by 150 mm

inputs.name: bayPrefix
inputs.description: Start of the Comments of the bays.

inputs.name: wallTypePrefix
inputs.description: Start of the wall type names.

inputs.name: offsetMm
inputs.description: Offset to set in mm, negative for down.

optionalInputs.name: viewName
optionalInputs.description: Plan view whose range is lowered; empty changes no view.

optionalInputs.name: viewBottomMm
optionalInputs.description: Bottom and depth offset of that view in mm.
